heading: What the store keeps
text:
### What the store keeps [NSTG.3.2]

The store keeps each record as the bytes it received and never decodes or
rewrites them ([LSTO.2.1]). Beside each it keeps what it selects by: the schema
name and `asserted_at`, the instant the fact entered working memory. The
argument carries both beside the bytes ([NCBK.6.10]), so the store indexes
without reading inside the record.

The store must keep every record it is given. It must not merge, replace or
drop a record because another resembles it: a fact recorded twice is two
records, and a hydration returning both is resolved by the engine
([RFCS.23.7]).

A hydration selects by schema and by `asserted_at` within the window, up to the
limit, and returns the bytes unchanged ([NSTG.4.3]). An integrator that needs
to find records by content keeps a record of its own beside DS's, keyed to it.
